summary: A patient, plan-aligned win: your pre-market and check-in both said you wanted NWOG filled once price failed to continue higher, and you shorted only after the manipulation into the 4hr unfill and a 5min displacement flip, then held it into lunch on 1 XFA for the full 1.53R. The finished entry now has the actual 11:01 short chart, and the box matches your logged RR exactly: entry 28,753.00, stop 28,891.25, target 28,541.75. Before that you missed the long off the Asia-low SMT and 4hr rejection block because you wanted a manipulation that never came, and the late entry from the restroom break cost you the tighter stop. Reflect and What i can improve on are still blank, so the journal says what happened but not what you'll change. The risk screenshot came in at 9:31 after the bot's 9:30 warning, I can't confirm the End of Day card from here, and Gmail shows no new eval or account purchases today.

rule: Tomorrow (Tuesday, election day), only take an entry while you're at the screen when it triggers, with the box drawn and the stop a few ticks beyond the protected high or low, not on it; if you miss the trigger, skip it instead of chasing a later, wider entry.

The box reads entry 28,753.00, stop 28,891.25 and target 28,541.75, which is 138.25 pts of risk for 211.25 pts, 1.53R, exactly your logged RR. Price had wicked to NYAM.H right into the 4hr line, and ES shows the matching high, then the 5min flipped back down through the 10:00 open. Your confluence list is written right on the chart. Two things: the stop is on the NYAM.H wick with essentially no buffer, and the entry sits well below the high, which is the cost of the late entry.

The finished journal now shows the real execution chart, and its box (138.25 pts risk, 211.25 pts reward) matches your logged 1.53R exactly, so your numbers are honest.

fix: Your stop at 28,891.25 is on the NYAM.H wick, not beyond it. A few ticks of buffer above the protected high costs little and keeps a stop hunt of the exact high from taking you out.

You missed the ideal entry because you were in the restroom, so you took a later entry with a 138-pt stop for 1.53R. Handle breaks before 9:30 or after you're in, not while you're waiting for the setup.

Waiting for a specific manipulation cost you a 2.6R long. Your own chart note said 10am would move fast after a 9:30 accumulation. If the confluences are stacked and the CISD prints, the CISD is the confirmation.
Reflect and What i can improve on are still empty. Fill them in tonight; that's where the lesson from the missed long goes.

The risk-settings screenshot was late: the bot warned at 9:30 and you posted 'oops' at 9:31. Post it together with the check-in card. I can't check from here whether you filed the End of Day card; if you haven't, file it before the 12 AM deadline.
You slept a lot less than usual. On short sleep, cut size or the number of ideas ahead of time, not after a loss.

questions.q: You wrote you 'wanted to see manipulation for me to long but we only accumulated an than manipulated higher.' Was a sweep below actually part of your written plan, or did you add that requirement in the moment?

You said you 'did lowkey miss the IDEAL entry bc i was in the restroom.' Where would the stop and RR have been from the ideal entry, and what will you do about breaks during the 10:00 to 11:00 window?

You wrote 'i took a 2nd entry after seeing the reaction i wanted to see.' Was that a second position added to the short, or do you mean the short was your second idea after the missed long? If you added, at what price and what was the total risk?

You wrote you were nervous 'cus i dont want it to come near my entry level,' and your stop sat right on the NYAM.H wick at 28,891.25. Why on the high instead of a few ticks above it, and what would you have done if price had come back up to 28,860?
